listings.description: This perfume is part of the Trilogy (Alfa, Omega & Id).The Scent. The beginning. Naked Venus rising from a clear blue sea. Deceiving in its simplicity, it tells a tale of earth, and milk, and vineyards, but its saffron heart contains deep yearnings for the sensuality of nutmeg, sandalwood, jasmine and thyme.

This perfume is part of the Trilogy (Alpha, Omega & Id).The last letter of the Greek alphabet denotes the end, the final limit. It is Alfa’s polar opposite, deriving its elegance and composure from the unawareness of its mortality. Its leather core is draped in velvet layers of Egyptian cumin and white musk. Iris and vanilla add sensual, gourmand and alluring touch.

This perfume is part of the Trilogy (Alpha, Omega & Id).Essential, rich, and wild, Id is the dark passion that drives us towards our dreams. Inspired by the local’s nickname for the volcano that towers over the island of Stromboli – Iddu. Id is an olfactory dedication to the fiery being that first breathed Mendittorosa into life. Impassioned and untethered, its iris heart awaits beneath volcanic sediments of violet, iris and oud. Overdose of labdanum gives Id truly niche and raw character.
An original creation on the theme of leather, a citrus opening of Bergamot and Elemi oil builds around White Lily, Ambergris, Musk and Sandalwood.

Le Galion created La Rose in 1950 and dedicated it to all women. The perfumer Paul Vacher who originally created the perfume, used to smell more than 70 species of roses every year in order to elect the one to be used in the composition of this elegant and subtle fragrance.Re-interpreted today with delicacy from the original formula, La Rose is not a true single flower fragrance since the main theme is enriched with sensual floral and refreshing aquatic notes. To finish, the Patchouli, Cedar and Musk leave a bewitching trail.

Le Galion's Iris is a reformulation of the 1937 scent of the same name, enriched with vibrant Citrus notes to make the central notes of Iris, Rose and Lily to come alive. A rich, warming base of Cedar, Amber and Musk finishes Iris in a classically sophisticated style.

listings.rawTitle: Special for Gentlemen Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A beautiful Oriental Amber fragrance that opens on fresh and aromatic notes. Subtle notes of lavender and lemon are accompanied by a touch of woody galbanum. A balsamic note of cinnamon brings softness to the blend. This lasting woody amber fragrance is achieved by generously combining amber, cistus labdanum and patchouli. Finally, soft balsamic notes and a slightly animalised note lend this sensual fragrance lots of sensuality - a marriage of vanilla, opoponax and castoreum.

Snob has a floral bouquet of white flower, paired with rose, to give a sensual effect. Spices including Iranian saffron bring a heat that is sublimated by precious woods: Australian sandalwood and Virginian cedar, surrounded by white musk.

The iconic fragrance of the House Le Galion and signature perfume of the famous Stork Jazz Club in New York in the 1930s, Sortilège returns today in a composition faithful to its origins. A floral aldehyde composition, beginning with a soft blend of white flowers and ylang-ylang from Madagascar. The explosion of its floral bouquet reveals Egyptian jasmine and delicate notes of mimosa, sustained by narcissus. Turkish rose is in the heart, partnered with Iris and leading into Indonesian sandalwood, vetiver and amber on a background. An intense, mythical fragrance.Sortilège has a balanced bouquet of perfect elegance: feminine, refined and distinguished - the scent of a mysterious and confident woman. Intense, elegant and sensual, it exhibits the perfect alchemy between perfume and skin.Although distinctly similar in style to the classic formula, please note this is a slightly revised composition, and not the same as the pre 2021 formula.

Le Galion launched Tubéreuse, this most narcotic of flowers in 1937. A creation inspired from an old formula in tribute to Paul Vacher's personal taste for single flower fragrances. The production was important to him as a perfumer, to maintain both quality and his own mental and creative agility.Ultra-feminine, sensual and intoxicating fragrance, reformulated from Le Galion's 1973 scent of the same name. Tubéreuse has a sparkling start, it opens with crisp and green accords, followed by spices and crisp fruity notes of raspberry and pear wrapped around the central note of tuberose. As the scent dried down, notes of cedar and warming amber are embraced by musk leaving a comforting and refined aroma.
The first fragrance by Aedes de Venustas is an outstanding edition with ahaute couture formulation.This rounded Chypre fragrance is characterised by its beautiful chicmiddle note of Rhubarb.

OEillet Bengale is a flower on fire. A rose that wants to be a carnation,set ablaze by an exotic spice explosion. The bright, peppery bergamot sends off the first sparks,followed by the incense stick which sets the scent ablaze.

Still Life is everything but a still Perfume.Inspired by Frédéric Lebain's playful picture of mirror balls, party streamers and confetti (a print is included in the box), the Perfumer Dora Arnaud have mastered a beautifully sparkling and vibrant fragrance. Its joyous opening is of a warm Japanese yuzu accompanied by a trio of earthy and spicy pepper notes. The transition between the bright opening and the warm base of amber and sweet notes of rum, enveloped by the bitter star anise and galbanum make for a playful, exciting fragrance that is nothing like a still perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Still Life In Rio Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Contrary of its name, Still Life in Rio is a vivacious and full of life perfume.The picture was taken by the Brazilian photographer Flávio Veloso, from the emblematic viewing platform of Corcovado, looking at the majestic statue of Christ and at the peak moment at dawn he captures Rio de Janeiro’s beauty. A moment in time that conveys peacefulness. The sky ignites and shreds its golden shroud.The Perfumer who composed Still Life in Rio is Dora Baghriche. The opening notes are an explosion of citrus with a piquant hint of spicy ginger and refreshing dash of mint leaf. A trio of pepper accords draw your attention and reveal the middle notes of sensual musky coconut water. The base notes are the grand finale of this carnival of a scent; Brazilian Copahu balm, which is beautifully embraced with sweet rum, just freshly poured into your glass. White leather accord adds modern finish to this joyous and vivacious scent, as the city of Rio.

Les Demoiselles means young ladies. Intense Tuberose flower that normally reveals its heady fragrance only from dusk, now in a candle. Tribute to the ladies of Paris who inflame the hearts on the French Cancan rhythm.

In Nomine Patris means in the Name of the Father. – From the damp crypts and the chapels that glorify our Saints rise swirls of incense smoke that elevate the spirit as well as the soul. The smell of cold, mossy stone, waxed wooden benches and torches, in the soft light of votivecandles.

Archetipo is the moment when we are ready to see beyond the reality. Shadows of what we really are, so far away, yet so close.Archetipo is the vision of the brand creator Stefania Squeglia, to re-enter the olfactory memory, to reach our inner thoughts and souls, and to lose ourselves in a time without time. Archetipo is the world, the space, the time, the imagination.The intricate composition opens up with intense incense and spicy accords, which linger for a while before the comforting labdanum, black amber and oakmoss take central strange. Bold, beautiful and forever lasting.

Rituale is perfumed blessing for your daily rituals, prayer whispering on your skin. It is your inner temple. Rituale doesn't follow the wind, it goes against it. Bless your day, create your own ritual.Rituale is here to stay, wrapped comfortingly around you like a smooth balm.

This scent is strong and full of personality. It is masculine and sweet.Sweet and convincing. It opens with a combination of African incense and bergamot, giving way to a woody heart of sensual sandalwood strengthened in its intensity by the patchouli. Tobacco leaf fills the base note. Vanilla and amber complete this very personal perfume.

This fragrance is both fresh and spicy with a classical twist.The top notes of incense, sage, pine and nutmeg give way to the middle notes of iris and wood chord. The base notes of amber, musk and vetiver provide unmistakable warmth.

A fresh green heady fragrance full of personality.Based on the famous Absinthe liquor, also called the “green fairy” (distillation of fennel) and banned for many years (still today in some places), it was the source of inspiration and madness of many Impressionist artists. This perfume is a truly forbidden pleasure.

The smell of good news and happiness. Positivity in a bottle.Daniel decided to create a very special scent, one that would convey simple happiness. After many tries he finally hit upon the right combination and was so taken that he named it after the person who fills him with energy, positivism, good vibes and love. With top notes of bergamot, rose and jasmine, the middle notes of patchouli, sandal wood and iris give way to the low notes of vanilla, praline and musk.

Just as a magical kaleidoscope, this perfume is orchestral. An infinity of raw materials with no set pattern and always a little different. A perfume on your skin with a unique fragrance each time your wear it because it cannot be deciphered, it changes without reason.

Shades of white flowers with magnolia taking the leading role.This scent is inspired by the flowers surrounding the elegant villas located around Lake Como in the North of Italy. A perfume for elegant people who don’t seek attention. Following the fresh, green and fruity top notes the hearty magnolia emerges with jasmine ascending softly and lightly into a woody base that envelopes it.

Intensity at its most passionate. Sensual and powerfully evocative.Its central flavour is oud wood, also known as agarwood. It is one of the most exotic and luxurious commodities known in the world. A treat for the senses! Different and unique!

A new page in the history of the House of Le Galion opens with a bridge between the past and the future. A re-interpretation of this lost formula - unleashing a mysterious and sensual fragrance creation built around an amber oriental accord.222 has a surprisingly soft opening with its mix of violet flowers and slightly sweet wood from the Kashmir. The contrast within this fragrance comes from the antique blending of aromatic balsamic, myrrh and styrax, contrasted with modern wisps of white musk. Sweet balsamic notes extend until the finish, allowing the wearer to discover the traditional subtlety of sandalwood and the refinement of leather.

The original vintage Eau Noble from 1972 which was a trailblazer and forerunner to unisex perfumery, and whilst remaining true to its origins and values, has had a remix and injection of new life 50 years on from it's debut. Perfumer Rodrigo Flores Roux has reimagined this vibrant fragrance, accentuating the energising green notes with a tart fruitiness that chimes with the zeitgeist.Tradition and modernity come together in a fusion of vivacity and effervescence.A new bottle for our times // Designer: Pierre DinandIn a twist of serendipity, the original designer of the 1972 bottle, was asked to reimagine the lines and bottle for this revised composition. Like the scent itself, the bottle is suave, streamline and super elegant - faceted glass just like Le Galion’s bottles were in the 1930'sPlease note this is a revised composition, and not the same as pre 2021 formula

Whilst remaining to true to the spirit of the 1968 vintage, we are presented with a revised composition of Vetyver in 2021, remixed for our times, in the interest of sustainability by Nicolas Beaulieu.An irrevocably masculine scent, seducing you to follow the trail of an enigmatic manInvigorating, fresh yet somehow dry and spicy too: the vetiver grass reveals itself - rooty, earthy, green and powerful - mingling with turmeric, mastic and violet leaf.

In a tribute to the aesthete and perfumer of the house, Le Galion has created Aesthete, an elegant and refined fragrance of Persian leather. Aesthete opens on Italian Mandarine, essence of Davana, hyperessense incense and Saffron, continuing on a leathery heart, Guaiac wood, Castoreum, Ouhd and Jasmin, all supported on a base of Sandalwood, Vanilla and White Musk.

A fragrance inspired by one of France's most popular and prolific writers, Romain Gary. He was authoring more than thirty novels, essays and memoirs, some of which he wrote under a pseudonym. Romain Gary achieved a literary subterfuge when he created Émile Ajar, and he became the only author to have won a prestigious French literary prize under two different names.He was the most glamorous of literary conmen, who married an iconic actress.Anonymity was his chance to reinvent himself, and to become manifold.But in the end, it seems that his fictions destroyed him.AJAR is a chameleon-like fragrance that speaks of incarnation. Dark oriental Incense meets dazzling orchid. A union as ambivalent and complex as human nature itself. The light and shadow within us all.

Inspired by Palais-Royal in Paris, a landmark of Parisian life, one of the most charming corners of Paris, naturally chic without ostentation. This is a powerful composition, with fresh opening notes, floral heart and chypre background, which reveals the sensual and seductive character of this perfume.

Inspired by the Rio's Botanical Garden blossoms and exotic trees. The perfume's composition is a bouquet of white flowers with green and slightly sweet notes, and dominating base note of licorice which gives the perfume a playful character.

Inspired by São Paulo, gigantic urban jungle, a cosmopolitan city, exuding a formidable vitality mixed with "dolce vita".This perfume is Giovanna's salute to this epicurean of a city who reinvents itself relentlessly.This is a spicy oriental composition, that leaves a honeyed trail mixed with beautiful saffron and intoxicating rum.

A steep, mineral cliff of incense dominates the olfactory landscape ofCopal Azur. Since copal resin cannot be used as a perfume ingredient, three different extractions offrankincense are used to conjure it from top to base notes.

Guaranteed to Please and Please and Please.An intensely beautiful leather scent. The top notes are saffron, raspberry and thyme; middle notes are incense and night blooming jasmine; and base notes are leather and suede with woody notes of amber.

This fragrance is dominated by a musky flavour. It has tender murmurings that are sensual and light.This scent is inspired by the fragrances favoured by the royal families of Europe who utilized musk and rose essence to perfume their hair and body. A sensual cloud of white musk spreads out around creamy textures of amber. It opens with a scent of muscone, angelica and abelmoschus seeds and it has a hearty flavour of Bombay wood and patchouli with rose and gives way finally to Balsam and further white musk.

Sumptuous and dark. Luxurious and sensual. Rich and exciting. Timeless.Orquídea Negra is long lasting and with a wide circulation aura. Its top notes are French jasmine, black truffles, ylang-ylang, blackcurrant and sparkling citric. The floral and spicy heart is the black from the orchids that name it, and the woody notes in the base combine patchouli and sandalwood with black chocolate, incense, amber, vetiver and vanilla.

A luxurious perfume with unique qualities and lots of depth. It has both character and strength!Pink berries, spice and nutmeg with soft and delicate hints of tagetes and grapefruit on the edges giving way to a majestic leather. The flavour is tropical with warm white, tuberose and ylang-ylang flowers laced with a touch of wild Heliotrope and Osmantus. Amber and flower vanilla add sensuality. The fragrance is wrapped in subtle oak moss and white musk.

Anthem recounts the story of Greece and its long journey towards freedom and independence. Two hundred years later, the core values of the revolution still apply to the modern "revolutionary" person : bravery, passion and integrity. Anthem brings the past into the future and unites the East with the West in its own distinctive way.The perfume composition opens with a golden glow of saffron and illuminating lemon note, which gently softens on the skin to make way for the exotic ylang-ylang and rose; the touch of cinnamon and nutmeg, takes the perfume into a rich, oriental dry-down while the layers of sumptuous oud, patchouli, amber, musk and the softest of vanillas, create a power perfume for the modern "revolutionary" man.Looking for the 10ml Travel Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

The name MEΘEXIS (Methexis) comes from the ancient Greek and means the communication between the divine and the human.MEΘEXIS is a sweet gourmand fragrance. A tribute to fig, one of the three most important seeds of ancient Athens which highly contributed to the city wealth. Artistically blended with honey and cocoa which brings out a milky yet delicious scent reminiscent of a Greek summer. The combination of the ingredients makes this a sophisticated sensual fragrance that balances the human animal self with the divine and higher self. It beautifully grounds our inner passions and emotions.Looking for the 10ml Travel Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

An authentic reinterpretation of classic 1940s Perfumery. Fatamorgana is a rich, green, woody powdered floral, with amber and sensual musk undertones.Imagine the Parisienne new look Haute Couture of the post war era, where women were empowered by dressers such as Balmain, Dior and Givenchy. Crisp, sharp, assertive, androgynous and just exquisite.The perfume formulation includes crisp green notes of Blackcurrant, Green Mandarin, Galbanum, Cardamom, underpinned by a feminine and elegant blend of Jasmine, Rose, Rosewood, Violet, Iris.Delving deeper into the olfactory abyss, we find in the base notes Sandalwood, Tonka, Amber, and Musk.A beguiling, bewitching, vintage style composition; full of decadent greens and classic floral elegance.A worthy successor to the original formula of Miss Dior (1947)

A contemporary take on the fresh blooms of spring - an impressionistic sketch of an imagined bouquet of lily-of-the-valley, Lily, and Lilac.Youthful, carefree, ethereal, and nostalgic, this floral lovers oasis of a green, wet and verdant garden, is where white flowers dazzle in the sunshine, immediately after a rain storm.Redolent of soft focus images of alpine meadows circa 1975, where Nordic beauties run barefoot through dew drenched wild flowers without a care in the world.A crisp, green floral with its olfactive roots firmly in the Seventies, but its blooms most definitely reaching for the modern horizons of today and hopes for a bright tomorrow.

A tribute to fig, one of the three most important seeds of ancient Athens which highly contributed to the city wealth. Artistically blended with honey and cocoa which brings out a milky yet delicious scent reminiscent of a Greek summer. The combination of the ingredients makes this a sophisticated sensual fragrance that balances the human animal self with the divine and higher self. It beautifully grounds our inner passions and emotions.Looking for the 100ml Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

Perfumer: Quentin BischA charismatic new re-orchestration of Ganymede, in the form of an exciting and exultant Extrait. Following on from the unmistakeable original, Marc-Antoine Barrois and the perfumer Quentin Bisch have revisited Ganymede and created a warmer, spicier, deeper interpretation, overdosing on immortelle and with the exciting and intriguing new additions of myrrh and incense."An ethereal untouched landscape, a distant star, an undiscovered planet.Through the shimmering heat, a vapour mist, an undulating panorama of dunes unfold before our eyes: just behind, endless golden fields of Immortelle flowers wave and falter, the sound of salty waves being drawn magnetically by the everlasting winds."This is a rarefied and exceptional Extrait, combining the very best of French "Savoir Faire" – individualistic, genderless, uncompromising on raw materials and created by one of the most exceptional Perfumers of a generation.

Character & Style: Bohemian, Loving, UniqueTwisted Iris is beguiling, artistic, and hedonistic with an enviously eccentric side that is insatiable and intriguing. A modern take on a 'Green' classic. A composition that blurs the lines between vintage and contemporary, countryside and the city; presenting a smooth 40's/50's vibe that suggests a heritage sillage. Redolent of a stately home furnished with quirky timeless panache.Crisp and vivacious, this composition has an elegant note of Iris absolute juxtaposed with fig and galbanum. Add a touch of violet, and carnal jasmine, mellowed superbly by a sensual dry-down of white musk and plush green moss.

Character & Style – Intellectual, Discerning, UnorthodoxThe reverie that transports us back to a Grandparent's attic, finding a fragile old book, yellowed pages falling, dust particles aplomb, an intense evocation of the past, brimming with olfactory nostalgia. A composition that is authentic and cerebral, comforting yet edgy – a touch 'Fin de Siècle' runs through its development, Dickens collides head on with a touch of grunge, resulting in a perfume of several guises and facets. It resonates and diffuses on your skin and to those close to you, with notes of frankincense, olibanum, myrrh and elemi, and a steadfast accord of patchouli, amber, vetiver and cedarwood."With an air of tenacity, this perfume is like a good book you just can’t put down".

Character & Style – Discerning, Assured, Fascinating"I always wanted to smell the delicious finesse of expensive suede on men and women and think of the closeness of skin." - AzziThis nocturnal composition is a tender mélange of Bergamot, Pepper and White Suede, underpinned by Tuscan Leather and smooth Violet Leaf. The chameleon like base is an enigmatic woods, rich resins and black musk.This is a scent for extroverts, self-assured and laidback, a perfume that holds fort, an olfactive love letter to sensuality and intimacy.

Character & Style – Rugged, Hypnotic, SensualThe inspiration behind this composition is the imagined scent of a rich, powerful alpha male who oozes sexuality and charisma. Debonair, effortlessly attractive with a timeless sense of style and presence.Ideal for the dapper English gent, this blends with your skin radiating an understated flair that compliments how your style narrates your story, in a memorable and stirring Perfume.The deeply mysterious, earthy scent of Vetiver is the central character here, with a supporting cast of cypress, laurel, and violet leaf, entwined with sequoia wood and complex clary sage.Beneath hovers an animalistic base of black oud and musk.

Character & Style – Steadfast, Soulful "This is the memory of a beautiful love affair."A pre-emptive olfactory bedtime love potion, its gourmand amber vanilla nuances making it a near edible sensorial experience. Evocative of nudes, and transparent soft glistening sheer tones.The delicate florals of muguet, pillowed by voluptuous tuberose - we find ourselves enveloped by the smoothest of sandalwoods, powdery musks, the resinous golden glow of rock rose and amber.Like an overdue embrace from someone dear, hugely comforting, enveloping, that touches the soul - alongside stirring the body's deepest desires.

Character & Style – Provocative, Inflaming and Wild"Evokes intense emotions with flair, sorcery, and an exotic twist."Inspired by a captivating woman under starlit skies, dancing on an Ibiza beach with a seductive trail. A concoction of Rose de Mai, Davana oil, Saffron, and Ylang Ylang forms the heart, while Oud oils, Benzoin, Musks, and red Woods add depth. A glamorous and unforgettable fragrance.

Character & Style – Seductive, Magnetic and Powerful"Initially crafted solely for Harrods, this alluring fragrance draws from the concept of a graceful Harrods apparition, elegantly joining festivities after the store shuts down."Inspired by toxic blooms, this fragrance emanates delectable, hedonistic, and captivating aromas. A blend of alluring Ylang Ylang, Freesia, and Neroli intertwine with magnetic Vetiver, Oudh, and Bois de Rose, layered over a base of Patchouli, Benzoin, Olibanum, and Musk. It weaves an enticing and potent olfactory tale yearning to be shared.

Character & Style – Fearless, Inflaming WildNarcotic florals, pheromone like musks and animalic nuances come together to create a harmonious explosion of erotic but sophisticated sensuality.A riotous Collab between noted fragrance designer Azzi Glasser and esteemed photographer Rankin, this perfume suggests desire, lust and passion. Somehow symbiotically floral, musky, fleshy, and salty, an erogenous composition that dares to create a (dis?)harmonious symphony of olfactory suggestiveness.Notes include : Magnolia, Leather and Jasmine, Castoreum, White Musks and Wood.Packaged in its own special scent storybook with bookmark, S&X makes a very special gift for a lover, a partner or maybe a token of self love to yourself.

Character & Style – Sensual, Creative, EdgyA modern yet unorthodox interpretation of a universal woody olfactive aura : fresh but in a piquant spiced manner, no predictable citrus notes, instead a resolute, uncompromisng and sophisticated perfume that 'walks its own road'.The composition centres around the rich scent of red Sequoia Wood, with Neroli and Palmarosa adding a fresh, androgynous element - awash with enigma and evasive panache. Underneath these intriguing notes, we find cedar, patchouli and white musk.From the perfumer herself: "This is my personal signature fragrance, it always brings me compliments, expressing creativity with individuality."Reflecting the conceptual idea of telling stories through scent, Sequoia Wood comes housed in a beautiful book 'box', complete with book mark and a soft velvet travel pouch.

Character & Style – Edgy, Urban, Contemporary, SophisticatedFrom the perfumer Azzi Glasser ‘The modernity of man with his past heritage still present’Drawing on the rich heritage of men’s perfumery, this is a shining example of past, present and future colliding to create a masculine ‘legacy’ perfume: not too fresh, not too heavy – a perfect balancing act of cold spices, smooth woods and the subtle addition of exotic ingredients sourced from the east.Elemi, Pimento and Bay create a crisp opening, with an underscore of Frankincense, Myrrh and Oudh. The Cedarwood, Vetiver, Labdanum and Amber create a contemporary Chypre accord which imparts complexity, dryness and decadence.Continuing the vision of the perfumer Azzi Glasser, this is housed in a beautiful scent storybook, complete with its own velvet travel pouch, and ingredient bookmark: where perfume always tells a new and unusual story.

Character & Style – Rugged, Understated, Alluring, SensualThe perfumers inspiration was the pheromonal scent of a working man, when body heat warms his just washed skin, the sensual aroma diffusing through a crisp white tee shirt.What initially smells innocent, quickly becomes a blush inducing melange of sensuous musk's, delicately layered over blond wood, with aquatic and earth nuances; finally settling to the naturalistic notes of armoise, cassis, and cypress leaves.A perfume for an understated, but cool and confident individual – the intensity of the perfume building and warming up slowly, leaving an arousing trail of intrigue long after the wearer has disappeared.Continuing the vision of the perfumer Azzi Glasser, this is housed in a beautiful scent storybook, complete with its own velvet travel pouch, and ingredient bookmark: where perfume always tells a new and unusual story.

SEΛENE (pronounced "Se-lee-nee") is named after the Greek goddess of the moon, who is often envisioned driving her chariot across the vast constellations and heavens. The inspiration for SEΛENE is the joyous memory of an Athenian summer night, perhaps in an an open air theatre or cinema – under the vast milky way and twinkling skies, a myriad of scents diffusing in the warmth of the evening, almost merging into one intense perfume – night blooming jasmine wafting from nearby neighbourhoods, the intermittent balm of citrus trees and leaves, and the delicious aroma of praline, echoing the gourmand sweets being consumed at the open air performance. Happy, tender, enveloping and authentic, this is a treat for the senses!

Created to celebrate the 10th anniversary of Manos Gerakinis Parfums, Sillage X is a thoughtful, joyful olfactive reflection on the passage of time and what remains timeless.Referencing the name of their very first fragrance, Sillage Royal, the fragrance recalls some of the fondest scent memories of the founder, Manos Gerakinis: the kind of refined, “masculine” perfumes that fascinated him as he was growing up - fragrances that many women, too, loved wearing, defying gender labels.The star ingredient of this extraordinary perfume is Vetiver - a tall grass with deep roots, that imparts a rich, green, plush yet earthy multi faceted aura.Mediterranean citruses, bergamot, lemon and mandarin, are the sparkling prologue, followed by hot vibrant spices of black pepper, cardamom, fennel seed, beneath these piquant top notes, the deeper aspects of the composition unfold with the soulful aura of orris, powdery yet complimenting the root-y facet of the central ingredient Vetiver.A grounding base of cedarwood, moss, and patchouli underlines the vetiver's earthiness, with an olfactive epilogue of glowing amber, sensuous leather, and skin-evoking musks adding an aura of sophistication and seductiveness.An ode to evergreen elegance, SILLAGE X blends together the enduring charm of the past, the exhilarating dynamism of the present, and the alluring mystery of the future.Made in Greece with plant based alcohol.Looking for the 10ml Travel Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

The House of Manos Gerakinis presents AMANDUS - the third gourmand creation, following the success of MEΘEXIS and Immortelle. Developed in collaboration with the talented Italian perfumer Sofia Bardelli, AMANDUS is sparkly sweet, playful and elegant. AMANDUS (Latin for "worthy of love") is a delightful fragrance that revolves around the almond note. In Greek tradition, its name evokes the timeless connection between the almond and eternal love, as an ancient myth tells of a heartbroken princess transformed into an almond tree by the gods, symbolising everlasting love. To this day, sugar-coated almonds are a cherished staple at Greek weddings. This fragrance captures the essence of love that transcends time, enveloping you in a luxurious scent that combines the almond's soft powdery nuances with rich caramel, buttery toffee, and toasted hazelnut. A delicate bou?quet of ethereal flowers adds a touch of elegance and sophistication, while the creamy, comforting base of sandalwood, vanilla, and musk* enhances the fragrance's soothing and pleasurable character. AMANDUS feels like a gentle, heartwarming embrace, lingering on your skin like a sweet, unforgettable memory. Its comforting gourmand aura echoes a love that never fades. *Synthetic Musk notes or accords. Manos Gekarinis Parfums do not use animal-derived products.

The holy Sanskrit texts possess a spiritual power that helps its readers explore their inner selves. Tara Mantra Eau de Parfum is an invitation to meditation. Its spicy, vibrant song diffuses the scent of monastic incense. Patchouli, enriched with woody and animal aromatic notes, awakens the senses. This fragrance evokes all the best that humanity has to offer.

In Oceania, master tattoo artists practice ‘tattow’ to mark the transition to a new stage in life. Moko Maori Eau de Parfum evokes victorious nobility, the very meaning of this practice. A sprouting fern called Koru symbolises strength and peace, offering a wonderful olfactory theme. Floral undergrowth is a main component of New Zealand’s lush nature. Honey-sweet Manuka flowers mix with Lichen to exude the scent of famous celestial legends.

The Japanese art of tattooing called Irezumi is a thousand years old. UKIYO -E Eau de Parfum captures our imagination, bringing to mind prints of the floating world and the Edo period’s Kabuki theatre. Sakura and Ashibi flowers endow this fragrance with poetic woody notes and hints of rose, while Genmaicha adds a delightful smokiness, creating an elegant, unique vapour trail that makes time stand still with its aromatic and aquatic notes.

When sideshows still performed throughout the United States, tattoos were a real attraction in the 19th Century circuses. While tattoos are considered an artistic statement today, at the time, they were they subject of curiosity.This parade of scents brings to mind carnival sweets and treats. Cotton candy and candy apple blend with the fantastic notes of hyraceum and leather, evoking the exoticism of the traveling circus.A freakishly attractive enchantment.

The muse: Emotions, perceptions, images, negatives, positives, everything we experience is stored in layers. Layer by layer, piece by piece... This is what defines us.Mon Âme is an exotic and mysterious perfume, resonating traditional perfumery, but ultra modern, which beautifully combines orris with mineral, earthy facets. This is the perfect iris perfume, a "fine line" between delicacy and opulence. A sophisticated round composition with soft woody notes, delicately powdery and floral, very long-lasting and almost impossible to forget its presence.

The Muse: Unbroken by milieu and circumstance, a self confident and balanced woman. She lives the life according to her own conceptions. Decisive, elegant and strong. She knows that the right decision is always that decision which moves her closer to her aim.Généviève is a love at first sight. It possesses the perfume aesthetics from a different era. Very rich and opulent floral perfume. Enchanting and reminiscing of classic perfumery that doesn’t exist anymore. Powdery opening, animalic and sharp aldehydes capturing the 1920s glamour scene. Leathery cloud unveils a floral bouquet of rose, ylang-ylang, jasmine and lily of the valley. Clean, clear vetiver and musk emerge just at the perfect time to surprise and impress.

Part of the Heritage Collection.Rose Poetique is a tribute to Damask Rose. A luxurious floral oriental fragrance whose mystery inspired Ancient Greek poets and claimed it to be the "pride of plants, and queen of flowers" {Sappho}.Manos Gerakinis describes it as Jubilation. A symphony of luxurious blooms blended with a distinctly leathery note, delicate and refined suede feel of saffron. Soft, spicy opening, which gently reveals the beauty of the sensual Damask Rose, taking you to a beguiling and plush journey.The raspberry note gives a delicate and dewy freshness as if the roses were freshly cut. Extraordinary duration, luxurious splendour.

Part of the Heritage Collection.Oriental and gourmand fragrance. Immortelle comes from the golden-hued plant everlasting flowers (Immortelle in French) or Helichrysum. Manos' interpretation of this honeyed note is on the sweet and spicy accents, with notes of cinnamon. The result is resinous without being heavy, balanced with sandalwood and benzoin, and the musky depth of the perfume gets better when it dries down and stays poised for hours.Manos describes the scent as Fortune, inspired by the good luck charm that the Everlasting Flower stands for.

Part of the Heritage Collection. A perfume that celebrates the delicate flower peony and Manos Gerakinis has made it sensual and luxurious. A rich bouquet of flowers, Pivoine is a perfume with many nuances, unusual for this type of flower. Slightly fruity with floral freshness, but the mystery lies in the nuances of the composition; sophisticated jasmine on the backgrounds, just enough without taking away the attention of the Peony. With velvety dry down, which manages to maintain the freshness of the composition, the result is a plush and sensual perfume. Manos describes this fragrance as The Lovers. Shaping of leaves, branches and flowers. Laces of petals shaping pure elegance, spells of eternal shyness while blossoming. Maître Jardinier is a labyrinth of greenery, hidden paths, freshly cut hedges shaping the silence of the gardens and become music through the patient hands of the gardener and his orchestrated gestures.Interested in the 10ml travel size? Click Here.

Scent of damp earth and grey water, kneaded and compact. Muted sounds, patter of raindrops on cement floor. Moulds ready to open, powdered plaster still poised. While the wheel spins, a dance of rhythm and sensuality, skilled hands fashion the shape, tools control and design, wet sponge caresses the shapes. The heated kiln and the earth grows strong in its fragile nature. Maître Céramiste is inspired by the ceramic art work of sculptors.The perfumer interpreted the atmosphere of the studio of a sculptor and the trade, by composing a harmonious notes of pink pepper that gives the sharpness of the tools. The plaster and clean dust are perceived through the iris notes and the incense guides into the shaping of the piece of art. The dry down of mineral accords of the scent represent the clay and round this composition up as a woody, spicy and amber based fragrance.Interested in the 10ml travel size? Click Here.

A fragrance inspired by the craftsmanship of shoemaker.Maître Chausseur takes us on a journey through soft leather, smokey notes accentuated with freshly ground coffee beans.Tools lined up on the steel table, tweezers working strands of leather. Sharp needles, battered moulds hold leather prototypes; fabric, rubber and the smell of glue heightens the emotions. Cardboard boxes and cotton sacks, brushes and wax for polishing, and all of this under the skllful hands of the artisan touch of shoemaker. Maître Chausseur resonates in this skillful trade as an oriental, aromatic and resinous fragrance.Interested in the 10ml travel size? Click Here.

Entering a tailor’s atelier and our senses are welcomed by the steam of an iron, the smell of different fabrics. The journey of a couturier begins with this musky fragrance when creating a suit or a dress. The experience moves into feeling the fabrics and this sense, the perfumer has given it by the freshness of the lavender flower and violet leaves, and finished with the roughest but deepest part - cutting, sewing and the sound of the machine piercing thought the fabric.Maître Couturier pays homage to the skillful tailor and their enigmatic world of creating beautiful clothing.The perfumer interpreted the couturier’s atelier into an aromatic, musky and woody fragrance.Interested in the 10ml travel size? Click Here.

Shards of reflected light, the glow of raw gold, freshly-cut gemstones, rusty tweezers but still strong to shape delicate jewellery pieces.Slowness, silence. A diamond is set, emotions are contained. The smell of metal, skilled hands shape the rubber to create the moulds, a glimmer of colours - ruby red, antique rose, pearl grey, bright yellow, emerald green. The perfume Maître Joaillier, honours the craft of the jeweller and it is imagined as a woody scent with notes of worked metal, woody and musky notes that round it up to pure luxury.Interested in the 10ml travel size?
